visualCharacteristics.structure: image gallery + heading + rating + size links + paragraph + CTA

contentPattern: 1 row x 2 columns. Cell 1: product images (front, back) - multiple images become the gallery. Cell 2: h1 product name; paragraph 'Choose a size:'; list of size links (current size first/bold); description paragraph; 'Shop Now' link (button). Rating is rendered from the bvId page metadata.
